description: 5 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-18 under road-to-steps-the-skill-cannot-skip AC-1, which repaired dead links in this skill's SKILL.md and so brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars cover creating a rule, rewriting one, deciding whether something should be a rule at all, the always-vs-auto classification, and converting a learning, with a German variant. Near-misses are the three exclusions this skill's SKILL.md names — multi-step workflow (skill-writing), reference material (guideline-writing), user-invoked action (command-writing). Counterexamples guard the 'rule' homonym in business validation and in lint configuration.

queries.q: add a rule that agents must never print secrets in their replies
rewrite src/rules/scope-control.md, the triggers fire on far too many prompts
should 'always run the formatter before commit' be a rule, or is it something else?
is this new rule always-loaded or auto? it's 140 lines and I'm worried about the budget
Wir haben gelernt, dass Agents nie ungefragt Branches löschen dürfen — mach daraus eine Regel
write a skill that walks an agent through migrating a Laravel app to Pest
queries.note: a multi-step workflow, which this skill's SKILL.md routes elsewhere → skill-writing

queries.q: draft a reference doc on our PHP naming conventions that skills can cite
queries.note: reference material agents cite → guideline-writing, named in this skill's SKILL.md

queries.q: create a /cleanup slash command the user can run to prune stale branches
queries.note: a user-invoked action → command-writing, named in this skill's SKILL.md

queries.q: add a validation rule that the invoice date can't be in the future
queries.note: 'rule' as business validation in application code, not an agent rule
